title: Raku Nights
evidence_sentence: Raku Nights is an evening raku firing experience where participants glaze and fire up to two pieces.
evidence_quote: Come and experience the excitement of raku firing, an ancient pottery technique that originated in Japan centuries ago
summary: Evening raku firing experience for ages 16+; bring up to 2 glazed pieces or glaze pieces on site. Approximately 3 hours, $125/person. Date rescheduled TBD.
bring: Up to 2 bisqued pieces, or glaze pieces provided on site
